final: WITH g AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.death_country,'') AS death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.death_country,'')) SELECT death_country, avg_points, avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM g) AS diff_from_avg_of_avgs FROM g
